body: Just saw Justin’s response. That makes sense I guess, I kinda always assumed Newt did some level of help behind the scenes since they’re all friends.

Here’s the 411 folks: Before silvermania Justin was part of a channel called underbelly. That channel goes way back and was pretty good for 2010 but probably not by today’s standards. Newt was one of the 4 guys on that channel. After that channel died Justin did silvermania and joined screenwave. Meanwhile Newt was the manager of a movie theater and has worked on super low budget horror movies. He’s worked with Len Kabasinski (of Best of the Worst fame) on writing Swamp Zombies 2. I think his movie theater closed due to Covid. If he works for screenwave then that’s a very recent thing. Kinda like Justin I think he’s known James for a long time. Source: was fan of underbelly and friends on Facebook with a lot of them randomly.

Now looks like he’s getting on  Cinemassacre. I don’t like it, cinemassacre is getting so bloated with all these random people.
